audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Gwen Levels 2-3 while the prose says 'Wukong owns the first three levels' and 'Levels 4-5 are still his'.
audit.corrected: Chart realigned in both layers; difficulty 6/10 lowered to 5/10 on a 51.85% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text with no timings.
audit.why: His spikes are Crushing Blow at 6-8s and Nimbus Strike at 7-10s; Gwen's are Level 6 Mist and Riftmaker against his stacked armour.
audit.corrected: Each phase why now names the ability and its cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Nimbus Strike is a targeted dash.
audit.why: Riot on Nimbus Strike: 'Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target' — it requires a target, so from outside Hallowed Mist, which only enemies inside it can target, he cannot open on Gwen at all. Riot on Crushing Blow: it 'gains attack range' (250 up to 350 by rank) and is an auto-reset, so his threat range is longer than his normal auto looks. Riot on Stone Skin: stacking armor while fighting champions — irrelevant against Snip Snip!, which is magic with a true-damage centre.
audit.corrected: Targeted-dash denial, the extended Crushing Blow range and the armour point written into the phase whys, cooldown block, dos/donts and interactions row.

audit.why: Nimbus Strike 10/9.25/8.5/7.75/7s, Crushing Blow 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, Warrior Trickster 22/21/20/19/18s, Cyclone 130/110/90s.
audit.corrected: Written into the cooldown block and trading rules.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Wukong contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Crushing Blow is an auto-reset that adds range and cuts your armour. He out-stats you at 1 — last-hit at the cone tip and give ground.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Wukong's Nimbus Strike is down.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike dashes to a targeted enemy at 650. That target is you, and you have no Mist yet.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Wukong must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash arrives. Snip Snip! is magic with a true-damage centre, so Stone Skin's stacking armour does nothing.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Nimbus Strike's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His last real window: Crushing Blow every 6-8s into a 7-10s Nimbus Strike, and still no untargetability to answer either one.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Wukong's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike needs a target — from outside Hallowed Mist he cannot dash to you at all, so his whole opener stops existing.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Nimbus Strike's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike — every point of Stone Skin armour he stacks only feeds your snips.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Wukong carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: You out-scale outright. Warrior Trickster's clone is the last trick: chase the body that dashed, not the one standing still.

edits.before: - Wukong Nimbus Strike: matchup-defining — His engage dash. Mist it, then Snip. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Wukong Nimbus Strike (7-10s): it dashes to a TARGETED enemy, so outside the mist he cannot open on you. - Crushing Blow (6-8s): an auto-reset with bonus range and armour shred. - Warrior Trickster (18-22s): clone plus invisibility.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Wukong with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Wukong wastes Nimbus Strike — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Wukong with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Nimbus Strike is spent — no gap-close for 7-10s, so commit the full pattern. Bad trade: standing at Crushing Blow's extended 250-350 range, which is longer than his normal auto and resets his swing.

edits.before: His engage dash. Mist it, then Snip. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It dashes to a targeted enemy — from outside the mist it cannot be cast.

edits.before: Wukong wastes Nimbus Strike — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike needs a target, so the mist deletes his opener.

edits.before: That is Wukong's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Warrior Trickster leaves a clone and turns him invisible — chase the one that moved.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crushing Blow adds range up to 350 and it resets his attack.

edits.before: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Stone Skin stacks armour while he fights, but Snip Snip! is magic with a true-damage centre anyway.

edits.before: Track Wukong's Nimbus Strike: His engage dash. Mist it, then Snip. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike dashes to a targeted enemy, so from outside Hallowed Mist he cannot open on you at all.

edits.before: Don’t Snip the clone — W-mist his dive and Snip the real body.
edits.after: Don't snip the clone — mist his Nimbus Strike, snip the body.

edits.before: At 6 you drop Hallowed Mist as his R spin winds up so the knockup whiffs and you go untargetable, then Needlework slow plus passive healing flip the all-in.
edits.after: At 6 Hallowed Mist blanks him: Nimbus Strike dashes to a targeted enemy, so from outside the fog he has no opener, and Needlework plus passive healing flip the all-in.

notes: Nimbus Strike being a targeted dash is what makes Hallowed Mist a hard counter to Wukong's opener rather than just a dodge, and it was absent from both layers. Crushing Blow's bonus attack range (250 at rank 1 up to 350) also means his threat range is longer than his auto looks. Kit file for Wukong is champ-data/_kits/monkeyking.json, not wukong.json.
